edges.description: README.ru.md is the fast human-readable entry into the current LLM-era Cognitive OS profile and its five cooperating planes.
ARCHITECTURE.md details the current model-era profile, while substrate-neutral cognitive law remains outside current technology choices.
The substrate-neutral boundary prevents LLM, storage, graph, retrieval, provider, framework, or hardware choices from silently becoming cognitive law.
The evaluation framework provides the route for testing Cognitive OS claims rather than relying on architecture prose or model confidence.
The evidence-use contract governs how cognitive research may inform this implementation-oriented profile without becoming automatic truth or owner authority.
FULL_HANDOFF.md preserves reopening continuity for future sessions, while live repository files remain the source for volatile current state.
ECOSYSTEM_RELATIONS.md records Cognitive OS local relationship claims that should be reconciled against Crosswalk and owning project sources.
The boundary explicitly places CLOS as the substrate-neutral research blueprint and Cognitive OS as a current implementation-oriented research/profile surface.
Cognitive OS local relations provide project-side context, while Crosswalk is the ecosystem-level relationship and ownership boundary map.
The Manifestos page stores human-facing declarations of meaning and values while explicitly excluding machine-manifest and technical authority semantics.
The Songs and Poetry page routes creative works and their narrative/interpretive context without requiring one canonical artistic reading.
The Archetypes page preserves human-story transitions such as Fugitive, Seeker, Keeper, and Creator as artistic devices rather than diagnoses.
The Fugitive page preserves the current interpretive transition from loss and flight toward observation, search, and knowledge.
The Notion Fugitive route points to the Drive long-form artifact for preservation, versions, and richer cultural context.
The Fugitive arc is the first current musical/human-story node inside the broader Songs and Poetry branch.
Fugitive→Seeker is one concrete cultural transformation expressed within the wider archetype/story layer.
The private Exo-Cortex root holds exploratory personal research and continuity material outside strict product/runtime authority.
Research Mode is the broad private notebook for observing, benchmarking, comparing, and proposing without direct Canon or runtime writes.
Personal Research Modules organizes candidate mechanisms such as hypothesis tracking, auto-linking, known unknowns, and negative knowledge before owner adoption.
Research Philosophy supplies the worldview and knowledge-creation rationale that may generate questions but does not itself authorize technical architecture.
Candidate mechanisms that need cross-project intake can be routed into Plan & Proposal without implying implementation or architecture promotion.
Research Mode preserves broad exploratory material, while the Working Master is the consolidated cross-project architecture/research synthesis used for deeper reconciliation.
Research Philosophy and Living Culture share human meaning and creative inquiry, while neither gains technical authority from that relationship.
